title: GNSS receivers and NMEA 0183: from satellites to a trusted fix
summary: Parse NMEA 0183 robustly (checksum, GGA, GSA, GSV), recompute PDOP/HDOP/VDOP from the satellite geometry with (GᵀG)⁻¹, estimate the range error UERE on a synthetic coastal drive near Sousse, and test NAVERA's real GPS driver against corrupted lines and an outage.
